description: The Tier-1 amendment artifact required by ADR-2606062100 + Charter Rider v3.0 §0/§6. A Council Lv7+ UNANIMOUS attestation that a proposed amendment to a Tier-1 Derived Policy (a Charter-Rider §2 prohibited-use category) serves a Tier-0 Priority at least as well as the text it replaces. Tier-0 priorities themselves are fork-only and can NEVER be amended via this record (structural invariant). Recorded on the kotoba Datom log (append-only, permanent — ADR-2606062100 §2).

amendsTier.description: INVARIANT — this attestation governs ONLY Tier-1 Derived Policy amendments. Only 'tier-1' is valid. (ADR-2606062100 §3)

tier0Immutable.description: INVARIANT — a Tier-0 Priority (wellbecoming / multigen / collective / permanent-memory / tithe-exists) can NEVER be amended by this record; only fork (founding a different association) changes it. Only true is valid. → :charter.amend/tier0-immutable

riderSection.description: The Charter-Rider §2 clause being amended, e.g. '2(a)', '2(d)'. → :charter.amend/rider-section

servesPriority.description: Which Tier-0 Priority the amendment is shown to serve. Each value is the EXACT Constitution.sol Tier-0 constant key (keccak256(value) is a registered constant). Drift-locked against the genesis by ConstitutionInvariants.t.sol::test_lexicon_servesPriority_matches_tier0_constants. → :charter.amend/serves-priority

conformanceFinding.description: INVARIANT — an amendment may only be attested if it serves the named Tier-0 priority BETTER or EQUALLY vs the text it replaces. 'serves-worse' is structurally unrepresentable (an amendment that degrades a priority can never be conformant). → :charter.amend/conformance

priorTextHash.description: keccak256 (0x-prefixed hex) of the Rider text being replaced; ties to Constitution.sol license.charter_rider_text_hash. → :charter.amend/prior-hash

proposedTextHash.description: keccak256 (0x-prefixed hex) of the proposed replacement text; becomes the new license.charter_rider_text_hash on ratification. → :charter.amend/proposed-hash

councilUnanimous.description: INVARIANT — Tier-1 amendment requires Council Lv7+ UNANIMITY (全会一致), not supermajority. Only true is valid. (Preamble §0.7; with a one-member roster, unanimity = that member's assent.) → :charter.amend/unanimous

councilApprovals.description: Count of Lv7+ member approvals recorded for this amendment (must equal the current Lv7+ member count for unanimity to hold). → :charter.amend/approvals

serverHeldKey.description: INVARIANT — no-server-key; the attestation is member/Council-signed, never platform-signed. Only false is valid (ADR-2605231525). → :charter.amend/server-key

proposedBy.description: DID of the proposing member/Council seat. → :charter.amend/proposed-by

supersededAttestation.description: Optional at-uri of a prior priorityConformanceAttestation this one supersedes (the record is append-only; supersession is a link, not a delete — 非終末論). → :charter.amend/supersedes

rationale.description: Human-readable justification of why the amendment serves the Tier-0 priority at least as well as the prior text. → :charter.amend/rationale

attestedAt.description: When the unanimous attestation was finalized. → :charter.amend/attested-at
